name: Renault
look: Two-tone canvas switched in full-bleed bands, sunlight yellow used scarcely, and square geometry with condensed stacked headlines.

hero.title: Small car, big personality
hero.sub: An electric city car with 400 kilometres of range, a design that references our own back catalogue rather than someone else's, and a price that starts under thirty thousand.

features.title: Designed for cities
features.sub: Compact enough to park, with the range and charging speed to leave one.

items.title: 400 km range
items.body: On the combined cycle, from a 52 kWh pack sized for a city car rather than a motorway cruiser.

items.title: 30-minute charging
items.body: Ten to eighty percent on a 130 kW charger, which is a coffee rather than a lunch.

items.title: Genuinely compact
items.body: Under four metres, with a turning circle that makes a multi-storey unremarkable.

items.title: Five real seats
items.body: A flat floor and no transmission tunnel, so the middle seat is usable by an adult.

items.title: Vehicle to grid
items.body: Sell power back when the grid needs it, with the tariff shown in the app.

items.title: Recycled interior
items.body: Seat fabric from recovered material, with the recycled content stated per component.

showcases.title: Charging that fits a day
showcases.body: A 130 kW peak on a pack this size means ten to eighty percent in half an hour. For a car mostly charged at home overnight, that is enough for the occasional long trip without over-specifying the battery.

showcases.title: Priced before you agree
showcases.body: Servicing, warranty extension and battery health checks all quoted as fixed prices published on the site, rather than estimated at the counter after the car is already on the ramp.

testimonial.quote: I bought it because it is small and I kept it because the charging genuinely fits a normal day. The design being lovely was a bonus.
testimonial.name: Camille Bernard

items.a: On the combined cycle. Expect roughly 320 in cold weather at motorway speed, which is stated in the brochure rather than left to be discovered.

items.q: How long does the battery last?
items.a: Warranted for eight years or 160,000 km to 70 percent capacity, with an annual health report included in servicing.
Fixed prices published per interval on the site. There is no estimate at the counter after the car is on the ramp.
On supported tariffs, yes. Vehicle-to-grid is included on Techno and above, with the export rate shown in the app before you opt in.

cta.title: CONFIGURE YOURS
cta.sub: From €28,900, with fixed-price servicing published up front.

notes: Two canvases switched in full-bleed bands: white for browsing, black for storytelling. Never a subtle gradation between them.
Sunlight yellow is a single accent used scarcely — primary CTAs, NEW badges and configurator indicators.
Headlines run at line-height 0.95 so condensed multi-line stacks sit cleanly on top of each other.
Geometry is square: 2px on buttons, nothing on tiles and product cards. Pills are reserved for sub-nav chips and badges.
Product tiles are photography-first — the vehicle full bleed inside an otherwise neutral card, with copy stacked beneath rather than overlaid.
